title: Review of c43's chasing-consumer negative: replicated on fresh seed 7 at dt 0.1; the drift up the prey field wraps prey (caps and rings) and frees almost no hunters (free share 0.062 -> 0.074 at chih 0 -> 10), while prey fall from 41 to 22
summary: labkit runs of the finding's world.py on seed 7 at the world step dt 0.1 (WORLD_P), chih 0 and chih 10, T=3000, --lineage-k 5. freeshare.py (free.py's measure applied to the recorded frames, t=1000-2000): free consumer share 0.062 (chih 0) and 0.074 (chih 10); prey bodies at t=3000 41 and 22. At chih 10 the consumers sit as caps and rings around prey droplets (rerun_chih10/sheet.png) and the consumer genealogy turns reticulate (merge/split 0.68 vs 0.11). The free-share rise is smaller than the author's 0.071 -> 0.156 on seed 0, which strengthens the negative.

observations.finding: rerun_chih10/sheet.png t=400-3000: consumers wrap prey as caps and rings, no free hunters; free share 0.074 vs 0.062 at chih 0 and prey 22 vs 41 at t=3000 (freeshare_s7.json)

controls_run.finding: rerun_chih0 (matched chih 0 arm, same seed, dt 0.1)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, chih 0 and 10 only (chih 5 not rerun), t <= 3000; free share counts frames every 40 t, not whether a free consumer reaches new prey.
